smoke_setup_attempts.error: disposable PostgreSQL did not become ready on loopback
smoke_setup_attempts.cause: The Docker network was internal, so host-loopback readiness could not reach the database.
smoke_setup_attempts.correction: Moved migration, seeding, and setup utilities into bounded containers on the same private network.

smoke_setup_attempts.error: invalid field 'rw' must be key=value pair
smoke_setup_attempts.cause: The Docker --mount option does not accept the standalone rw modifier used in the mount string.
smoke_setup_attempts.correction: Removed the redundant rw modifier; writable result mounts remain writable by default.

smoke_setup_attempts.error: camera_events relation missing during the smoke request
smoke_setup_attempts.cause: Alembic resolved server/alembic from the cached image workdir instead of the mounted worktree.
smoke_setup_attempts.correction: Set utility and app workdir to /work and PYTHONPATH=/work/server/src; verified Alembic head 0008_camera_events and imported source paths.

smoke_setup_attempts.evidence: Real migrations, login, authenticated HTTP route, and both CSV modes passed the 100-row smoke; both outputs were 9834 bytes with SHA-256 99a073d10efc1924c7e70a84905a7d902f8bf55ce378556ebbb359f687dfc79d.
